## Benchmark Reproducibility

You can re-run the official benchmark suite at any time:

```bash
bun run bench
```

To save a baseline reference and compare your future modifications:

```bash
# Save current version results
bun run bench:save

# Automatically compare with baseline
bun run bench:compare
```
